title: PREventative Study Against URate-Lowering Drug-Induced Gout Exacerbations (PRE-SURGE 2)
brief_summary: The purpose of this clinical research study was to determine the safety and effectiveness of an experimental drug called rilonacept in participants with gout who are beginning allopurinol treatment for gout. Participants will participate in this study for approximately 22 weeks. Rilonacept was being studied for use in preventing allopurinol-induced gout flares.
